The '''Beharen Droid Factory''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing installation located in the [[Labor Valley]] district of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. It specialized in hazardous maintenance units designed specifically for disaster relief and recovery operations; these droid models were built to withstand high radiation, extreme temperatures and falling debris.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Beharen Droid Factory}}</ref>
